retrieval_strategies.note: Typed text, vector, and hybrid query strategies retain the native Azure AI Search and Databricks AI Search execution paths.

provider_reranking.note: Azure semantic ranking and Databricks reranking remain provider-native capabilities selected through typed query options.

agent_decision_observability.note: Strict provider-neutral decision records use privacy-governed MLflow AGENT spans; observed execution spans remain authoritative and provider reasoning signals remain optional diagnostics.

provider_native_async_streaming.note: aai-core configures and returns native async clients; callers own their event-loop-local lifecycle and native stream types.

foundry_cloud_evaluation.note: Response-ID and agent-target evaluation are current; trace and conversation evaluation remain preview.

foundry_a2a.note: New integrations target A2A v1.0; project connections, RBAC, and agent cards are provisioned externally.

foundry_context_engineering.note: Agent Framework context providers and Responses compaction are current; managed Memory is preview.

otel_dual_export.note: One OpenTelemetry provider can fan spans to Application Insights and an MLflow OTLP endpoint; there is no backend-to-backend synchronization.

langgraph.note: Supported through MLflow LangChain autologging; graph and state APIs are not wrapped by aai-core.

production_feedback_curation.note: Scorer sampling registration runs from a Databricks notebook; aai-core supplies judge resolution, feedback, and trace curation.

self_service_analytics.note: Semantic contract, warehouse executor protocol, and provenance discipline are generated application code in analytics-app; aai-core wraps none of it.

agent_evaluation_toolkit.note: agentkit CLI: comparison-first evaluation, shared scorer registry, promotion gate
